name: Adobe
description: Adobe is a software company whose Developer Console issues credentials for Adobe APIs and services.
notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. Candidate credential families enumerated from the Adobe Developer Console authentication documentation on developer.adobe.com read on 2026-10-04 (sources developer-adobe-com-0dbe3ed00c, developer-adobe-com-69389b938d, developer-adobe-com-09955d5cc6, developer-adobe-com-e0b4921a8f, developer-adobe-com-e03016dc42, developer-adobe-com-d4709006da, developer-adobe-com-c376393c79, developer-adobe-com-dda8443c8d, developer-adobe-com-5b68f910c4); the list is what those pages name, not a complete inventory. API key credentials and client IDs are public identifiers, not families: the API key credential contains only an API key and no secrets.
